gaps.explanation: The Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - Disaster Recovery Fund (p12) prints one DISBURSEMENTS actual line 6,769,858 (recorded as the Disaster Recovery Fund detail disbursement line), which includes the Transfer to bonding agent. The governmental funds Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances (p5, Disaster Recovery Fund column) prints TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS 455,872 (Principal paid 255,000 + Interest paid 163,667 + Bond costs and fees 37,205) and shows 'Transfer to bonding agent' (6,313,986) under Other Financing Sources (Uses); the Total Governmental Funds column (p6) likewise prints TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS 8,806,927 and (6,313,986) under other financing. 6,769,858 - 455,872 = 6,313,986 = the gap exactly. The budget schedule classifies the bonding-agent payment as a disbursement while the statement classifies it as an other financing use; both printed as such, so no fix.
